cases.title: Verify that the CMS Accessibility Settings page renders the Accessibility Tools Enabled toggle

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as Site Content Editor
steps.expected: Login succeeds

steps.action: Navigate to Global Components -> Header Management -> Accessibility Settings
steps.expected: Page displays the Accessibility Tools Enabled toggle in its current saved state

cases.disposition_reason: Read-only render check

cases.title: Verify that the image upload dialog renders both Alt Text (EN) and Alt Text (AR) input fields

steps.action: In CMS, open any content item's image upload dialog
steps.expected: Alt Text (EN) and Alt Text (AR) input fields are both visible and marked mandatory

cases.disposition_reason: SKIP-SPEC-GAP: guide §3 gives AccessibilityHeaderConfiguration only accessibilityToolsEnabled; no object in the guide carries these image Alt Text (EN/AR) fields — requirements-vs-implementation conflict per cms/Content-Admin-Guide.docx, escalated to QA Manager/BA 2026-09-30.

cases.title: Verify that a CMS user without header-management permission cannot access Accessibility Settings

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as a user without accessibility-settings permission
steps.expected: Login succeeds with restricted role

steps.action: Attempt to navigate to Global Components -> Header Management -> Accessibility Settings
steps.expected: System blocks access and displays 'Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action.'

steps.action: Switch CMS locale to Arabic and repeat the attempt
steps.expected: System displays the Arabic equivalent message in Arabic locale

cases.disposition_reason: Non-mutating access-denial check

cases.title: Verify that enabling Accessibility Tools Enabled = True saves and publishes successfully

steps.action: Open CMS Accessibility Settings
steps.expected: Settings page opens with current value

steps.action: Set Accessibility Tools Enabled = True
steps.expected: Toggle set to True

steps.action: Click Save and Publish
steps.expected: Liferay generic success toast displays; configuration saved

cases.disposition_reason: SKIP-SINGLETON: saving/publishing/unpublishing the one live AccessibilityHeaderConfiguration entry changes shared qcdev for every visitor; user declined 2026-09-30 (standards 'Destructive-Precondition Tests Must Use Disposable Test Data' rule 5). Needs ID-named approval.

cases.title: Verify that changing Accessibility Tools Enabled without saving can be discarded

steps.expected: Settings page shows True
